author: Kusha N M

lines: ಜಠರ ಸೀಳುತ ತಾನೆ ಕಷ್ಟ ಕೂಪದಿ ಬಿದ್ದು

raw:
ಕಠಿಣವಾಸವ ಜೀವಿ ತಾಯ ಗರ್ಭದೆ ಕಳೆದು
ಶಠವೆನುವ ಮಾಯೆಯೊಡೆ ಭೂಮಿಗಿಳಿಯುವುದು
ಜಠರ ಸೀಳುತ ತಾನೆ ಕಷ್ಟ ಕೂಪದಿ ಬಿದ್ದು
ಹಠವ ರೂಢಿಸಿಕೊಳುವ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: A being spends a hard stay in the mother’s womb,
and comes down to earth along with a cunning illusion;
splitting the belly, it falls into a well of hardship,
and learns to be stubborn, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: From its difficult time in the womb, a being is born into a world of illusion and struggle, and learns stubbornness from the start. Awareness of this can help us soften.
